items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: the tenor sax who was working there at the time I used to sit in was Artie Drillinger

ctx.x: Who was at Adrian's Tap Room then?

There was a little four piece group. One thing I remember, Willie Lyon Smith was playing there on the single piano. And this little four piece group had a bass and a tenor sax. And Adrian would often play vibes with it, but he was also busy managing. He wasn't always on the bandstand. And I believe the piano, probably drums. And the tenor sax who was working there at the time I used to sit in was Artie Drillinger, D-R-I-L-L, Drillinger. And he's still around. He's somewhere, I think he's up in the studios now.…
And he was a hot man there though.
